a directory behind the identifiers records are keyed by, the disclosure-context port and Profile's commands, adapted by the host in Profile's own terms; there is no package dependency
the signed-in principal for each /api/profile request, through the host's subject resolver; there is no package dependency
whether a viewer may see a group's suspended members by name, through the host's access-decision port; there is no package dependency
